description.text:
Elmira Little Theatre presents

Mel Brooks’ YOUNG FRANKENSTEIN

Book by Mel Brooks and Thomas Meehan
Music and Lyrics by Mel Brooks
Directed by Kaylara Allington
Music Directed by Nolan DeSanto

in Powers Theater

Friday, August 14, 2026
7:30pm

Saturday, August 15, 2026
2:00pm & 7:30pm

Sunday, August 16, 2026

Pricing

General Admission Tickets:
Adults: $35
Seniors/Students: $30
Clemens Center Members: $28
Groups of 6 or more – $28/person

Mel Brooks’ madcap comedy collides with Mary Shelley’s classic monster tale in Young Frankenstein. Victor Frankenstein, the mad scientist of legend, has died and left everything to his grandson, Frederick, who wants nothing to do with the family’s notorious legacy. To settle his inheritance, he travels to his grandfather’s castle in Transylvania, meeting the grandson of Victor’s loyal henchman, Igor; the beautiful lab assistant, Inga; and the mysterious Frau Blücher. Before long, Frederick is sucked into his grandfather’s experiments and succeeds in creating human life. But by the time they realize that the Monster’s been accidentally given an abnormal brain, the Monster has already escaped, seemingly set to terrorize the countryside like the Frankensteinian monsters before him. Will Frederick repeat the mistakes of his grandfather? Or will he succeed where the others have not and turn his Monster into a dapper, intelligent man about town? Young Frankenstein is a hilarious take on the classic horror story, combining zany antics, a witty script, and high energy comedic performances for one unforgettable, hilarious adventure in Transylvania.

Dates/times/programs are subject to change.

Tickets: https://clemenscenter.org/event/elmira-little-theatre-presents-mel-brooks-young-frankenstein/.

summary.text: An Evening with Ira Glass at The State Theatre, Ithaca

description.text:
DSP Shows & WSKG Public Media Present:
An Evening With Ira Glass
Saturday, September 19th, 2026
Doors: 7pm, Show: 8pm
Tickets on sale Friday 11/21: https://tixr.com/e/164362
Ira Glass is the host and creator of the public radio program This American Life. The show is heard each week by over 5 million listeners on public radio stations and podcast.
Glass began his career as an intern at National Public Radio’s network headquarters in Washington, DC in 1978, when he was 19 years old. He put This American Life on the air in 1995. He also served as an editor for the groundbreaking podcasts Serial, S-Town and Nice White Parents.
Under Glass’s editorial direction, This American Life has won the highest honors for broadcasting and journalistic excellence, including nine Peabody awards and the first Pulitzer Prize ever awarded for audio journalism. In 2021 This American Life episode ‘The Giant Pool of Money’ was inducted into the Library of Congress’s National Recording Registry, the first podcast ever so honored. In 2025 This American Life, Serial, S-Town and Nice White Parents were listed on Time magazine’s 100 Best Podcasts of All Time.

summary.text: TRL! Music on the Terrace feat Maddy Walsh Trio

description.text:
TRL! Music on the Terrace Featuring Maddy Walsh Trio

 
 
 

Wednesday, August 12, 2026

6:00 pm - 8:00 pm

Location: The Rockwell Museum

Open to the public | Rockwell Members: Free, Not-Yet-Members: $15 | Advance registration required by 5:00 p.m. on August 11 

Help us celebrate The Rockwell’s 50th Anniversary at this year’s TRL! Music on the Terrace Series, a special season honoring the Museum through live music, cocktails, and art! 

In celebration of this milestone year, the TRL! Music on the Terrace series will take you on a musical journey through the decades. Each month features a live band performing hits inspired by a different era, creating a nostalgic “through the eras” experience on the Terrace. From the sounds of the 70s and 80s in June, to late 80s and 90s in July, and early 2000s and beyond in August, each band will bring a unique nod to the Museum’s history and create a vibrant summer vibe. 

Enjoy light refreshments and specialty cocktails inspired by works from the Museum’s collection and current exhibitions. 

Event Details 

  • Light refreshments, specialty cocktails, and cash bar. 
  • Museum members receive a complimentary drink ticket. Not yet a Rockwell Member? Join today! 
  • Event takes place rain or shine. 

Maddy Walsh (front person of nationally touring, five-piece “Moxy Rock” band Maddy Walsh & The Blind Spots) has formed a trio with Blind Spots’ guitarist / songwriter, Mike Suave, and the band’s backing vocalist / keyboardist, Rozlyn Menachof. The project is a stripped-down, softer version of MW&TBS and includes some Blind Spots material, songs from Walsh’s solo records, and some choice covers that feature lush three-part harmonies. Where the full band offers a “dance party love’splosion” (in Walsh’s own words), the trio offers an opportunity to tune in to the complexity of the lyrics and the virtuosity of her voice.
Mark your calendars for Music in the Park this summer!

summary.text: Duck Drop Fundraiser at Eldridge Park

description.text:
Watch the rubber ducks drop from the sky for your chance to win $1,000 at Eldridge Park this September! In conjunction with our Future Firefighters Fun Fest, Eldridge Park is selling numbered rubber ducks throughout the summer for $5.00 each.

On Sunday, September 13th at 3pm, the ducks will be hoisted in the air by a 100-foot ladder fire truck and positioned over a target on the ground. One thousand ducks will be released and the Lucky duck that lands closest to the target will win $1,000 cash courtesy of Margeson Insurance. Tickets are on sale at the Eldridge Park Gift Shop all summer long.

Saturday and Sunday (September 12 & 13) will feature the Future Firefighter Training Show which includes a smoke house, simulated fire scenes and their epic water cannon. In addition, local Fire Departments will be on hand with their vehicles and equipment while doing actual demonstrations of rescue diving, water rescue, Motor Vehicle extractions, Hazardous materials
responses and more.

The Duck Drop will cap off the fun-filled themed weekend and the public is encouraged to watch the Ducks Drop live.

summary.text: Camp Scampi - Music, Food & Arts Festival!

description.text:
Event by Camp Scampi, Noetika and 6 others
 
7222 NY-417, Addison, NY
Public
 
Big Shrimp, in coordination with Sage Entertainment & Moe Town, is thrilled to announce the inaugural lineup for Camp Scampi, a three-stage Music, Food, & Arts festival taking place August 28th & 29th at Moe Town Music Venue in Addison, NY.
2-Day Passes and more info, now available at https://www.campscampifest.com
We’re beyond excited to present two nights and four sets of Big Shrimp, alongside an incredible lineup of artists including Spafford, Space Bacon, Jimkata, Tand, Muscle Tough, and many more. Representing the Northeast’s jamgrass community, we’re proud to feature The Dirty Grass Players and Folkfaces.
Our campground area will host a Renegade EDM stage running all weekend long, headlined by a special Saturday late-night set from Denver's Noetika, plus a lineup of talented DJs. Music on the Main Stage & EDM Stage will run until at least 2AM each night.
We’re excited to partner with the online community You Enjoy MyFood to bring food-focused activities to the campgrounds all weekend long, channeling the spirit of Phish’s MondeGreen festival in Pod 8.
Art installations will be curated by the incredible Kozmik Sirkus Productions, known for Big Shrimp's annual Halloween Extravaganza productions, while Sonic Odyssey Productions will be providing top-tier sound, lighting, and visual production.
Our mission, It’s As Shrimple As That: Bring festivals back to what made them special in the first place—community, companionship, and the power of live music. No unnecessary barriers. No cash-grab culture. Just a shared space where people can unplug, come together, and be part of something real.
No VIP tiers here—because at Camp Scampi, everyone is a Very Important Prawn Star.
Camp Scampi is a two-day affordable event, and we believe a festival in 2026 can be done like it was in 1996 (yes, before we were born), and bring it back to the way it used to feel: free-spirited, affordable, and built around genuine human connection. It’s Big Shrimp’s gigantic end of Summer party, and EVERYONE is invited!
This is Camp Scampi.
